sermon.title: Rulers Must Be 11/04/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In the ninth session of Bible truths only cons disagree with, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that rulers must be just, punishing evildoers and honoring good doers. He lays out seven areas of authority—God, Jesus, husband, family, civil government, church and the individual—all aimed at saving people from the lake of fire.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Group percentages are kept as spoken and were not checked.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: If anyone will not work, neither shall he eat.
Whoever has no rule over his own spirit Is like a city broken down, without walls.
For if by the one man’s offense death reigned through the one, much more those who receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness will reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ.)

faqs.question: What share of Americans are Protestant, per him?
How many biblical areas of authority does he list?
What does he say about boys and girls?
faqs.answer: Let boys be boys and girls be girls.

faqs.question: When can civil authorities step into a church?
faqs.answer: When crimes like sexual abuse happen; otherwise they have no authority over the church.

faqs.question: Miracle vs. healing?
faqs.answer: A miracle is something men cannot do; healing can come by medicine, doctors or time.

faqs.question: Does failing make you a failure?
Does the Bible forbid tongues?
faqs.answer: No; forbid not, but in order and interpreted.

faqs.question: What harvest does he expect?
faqs.answer: A number no man can number in this generation.
